resources.string:
"What is new in this update

## Faster Termux pane updates
- The existing Termux workspace now refreshes from terminal output instead of repeatedly polling for screen changes.
- Termux still runs your shells and jobs. The same terminal tiles, input controls, layouts, fonts and themes remain available.
- Improved Unicode paste, terminal colors and cursor restoration after resizing or reconnecting.
- Helper updates preserve existing shells and jobs. Use Update now when prompted to install the matching bundled helper.

## IRC reconnect and mentions
- Reconnecting to a channel now requests the server's recent retained history when IRCv3 CHATHISTORY is available.
- Channel members refresh after reconnect, and typing @ offers the current channel's nicknames for quick mentions.
- Replayed messages are deduplicated and do not create false unread counts.

## Native IRC
- Talk through standard IRC with channel and private-conversation chips, Channels, People and concise Help. Slash commands remain available.
- Sign in through one prompt; optional device-key authentication reconnects without saving your password.
- Messages appear immediately. Pending or uncertain sends are labelled; duplicate server echoes and automatic retries are avoided.

## Calculator
- Terminal input with 123, ABC and FUNC key layers for numbers, units, variables and functions.
- Live hints preview how Qalculate interprets your expression and its possible result.
- Continue from the last answer: 5+5 gives 10, then +5 gives 15. Assignment and conversion controls are easier to reach.

## Floating tools and Help
- Calculator, Help and IRC share raised headers, inner panes, theme-controlled borders and remembered window sizes.
- Calculator and Help stay expanded in landscape. Help closes with Back and remembers your place; calculator help leaves your calculation intact.

## Termux workspace
- A separate workspace with two independent terminal tiles, split layouts and multiple pages. Existing shells and jobs keep running when you leave.
- The workspace checks its helper and offers Update now / Later. Updates use the matching helper bundled with Launcher, with checksum verification and installation-failure recovery.
- Improved Unicode input, resizing and reconnect restoration.

## Launcher
- Guided first-run setup with live border previews and a terminal-style build animation.
- Classic/Search controls, optional search-category tabs and independent app-drawer rail appearance controls.
- Portable preset sharing/import, an optional idle fade, improved unlock tracking and the JetBrains Mono Nerd Font Regular default.

## Before you start
- Termux still needs its command permission, external-app access, tmux, socat and gawk. The update prompt offers setup guidance when needed.
- IRC uses TLS, not end-to-end encryption. Server operators can read messages; closing the IRC pane disconnects.

You can reopen these notes with the changelog command. These highlights are bundled with the installed app and work offline."
